---
title: "Data Downloads"
---

Links to the simulated data files used in the workshop examples.

The district datasets now include both outcome scales: `outcome_std` for standardized-effect models and `outcome_raw` for easier-to-read graphs. The raw score is a rescaled version of the standardized outcome: `outcome_raw = 50 + 10 * outcome_std`.

| Dataset | Purpose | Downloads |
|---|---|---|
| `simple_did_district` | Traditional DID, TWFE, and event-study examples with one treatment cohort. | [CSV](assets/data/simple_did_district.csv), [Stata](assets/data/simple_did_district.dta) |
| `staggered_did_district` | Preview dataset with early adopters, later adopters, and never-treated districts. | [CSV](assets/data/staggered_did_district.csv), [Stata](assets/data/staggered_did_district.dta) |
| `data_dictionary` | Variable names and descriptions. | [CSV](assets/data/data_dictionary.csv) |
| `workshop_estimates` | Reference estimates from generated examples. | [CSV](assets/data/workshop_estimates.csv) |
